items.text: I need to text my employees about schedule changes, but we have no developer and nobody wants another app. What are my options?
items.detail: Leads with the situation, then the two limits.

items.text: Is there a way for a small office to send text alerts to staff straight from email, without paying a developer or installing a new app?
items.detail: Names email as the tool they already use.

items.text: Our crew ignores emails. How can I start sending them text alerts this week without hiring someone to build it?
items.detail: Adds urgency and the crew's habit.
